titulo: Your plan: one step at a time
titulo_curto: Your plan and the final video
lead: You've now seen all four steps. Now it's time to build the plan with dates, do the exercises in order, and only move up when the "done when" is true.
objetivo: leave with a dated action plan and know how to measure whether each step is solid.

aprende.t: Review the whole journey on video

secoes.sub: The four steps, the 23 exercises, and what each step delivers. Tap an exercise to see its "done when".

degraus.saida: An agent working in your folder, with a safety net.
degraus.passo: The foundation of everything. Six exercises take you from your first mkdir to the agent reading your files and citing the source. Without this step solid, the other three stall.

degraus.saida: An assistant of your own, with memory and a routine you actually use.
degraus.passo: Requires step 1 (terminal, folders and .env). From the design in meu-jarvis.md to a routine used five days in a row; the memory test takes two days.

degraus.saida: Tasks running overnight, with a gate on what matters.
degraus.passo: Requires steps 1 and 2. The queue on paper and the homemade queue come before the bot; the task night shows how many come out right on the first try.

degraus.saida: A niche channel with the source on screen and a schedule with a gate.
degraus.passo: Requires the previous three: without a queue and without a gate, automating social media just means posting wrong faster. Ends with a week of manual approval.

resultado.titulo: At the end of the training
resultado.texto: An agent in your folder, an assistant of your own, a queue with gates, and a channel with the source on screen.

rolagem_fim.texto: Four steps in sequence, each with its own list of exercises and a verifiable criterion. Only move up when the "done when" of the previous step is true.

secoes.legenda: Required order: each step uses what the previous one built.

secoes.sub: Pick a start date and how much time you have per week. The plan respects the exercises that need days of real use.

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and the rule I created

itens.texto: The gain doesn't come from a new model: it comes from taking the work out of the chat and putting it in a folder with rules, Git, and secrets kept out of the text.
Terminal, assistant, queue, and social media. Each one builds on the one before, and "done when" tells you when to move up.
A gate before what matters, a refusal that becomes a rule, and the source on screen. Automating isn't letting go.

secoes.sub: Two and a half minutes to review the four steps before you start.
Four questions about the whole program.

perguntas.p: What is the order of the steps?
perguntas.explica: Terminal, assistant (Jarvis), queues, and social media. Each step builds on the one before.

opcoes: A checkable criterion so you know whether you can move on.
That the exercise took the stated amount of time.
That the agent won't make mistakes.
perguntas.explica: It's the criterion you check: only move on to the next exercise when it's true.

perguntas.p: Which of these should never go into a text file in the project?
perguntas.explica: Token and keys stay only in the .env, which is in the .gitignore. This applies from step 1 to step 4.

perguntas.p: A flow is going to post on the company's behalf every night. What must be in place from the start?
perguntas.explica: Without a queue and a gate, automating social media just means posting the wrong thing faster. The gate only comes off after days in a row without a refusal.
